platformDescription: A platform key is a service account for an external client or service. It names the person it acts for on each request, so within the scopes you grant it, it can act as any active user — grant the narrowest set that does the job, and an expiry.
platformEmpty: No platform keys to show. This list holds only the ones you are allowed to see, so a key can exist without appearing here.
name: Name
scopesHelp: A key with no scopes can do nothing. Grant the read-only variant where the client only needs to look.
allowedIpsHelp: One per line. Plain addresses or CIDR blocks. Leave empty to allow any address.
created: Copy this key now — it is never shown again.
notManageable: Provisioned for you by someone else — you cannot change or revoke it.
endpointHint: Send it as an Authorization header: Bearer '{'token'}'
copyFailed: Could not copy it for you — select the key above and copy it yourself.

personal.title: API key
personal.subtitle: One key that lets an AI assistant — Claude Code, for instance — do a few things in ExpenseOS on your behalf. There is nothing to set up: every setting is fixed.
personal.smallScreenBody: Requesting or regenerating a key shows it to you once, and it has to be pasted somewhere before it is gone. That is a thing to do at a computer — open your profile on a larger screen when you need a key.
personal.smallScreenLiveBody: You hold an API key, and you can revoke it here — that is the one thing you should never have to find a computer for. Requesting or regenerating one shows the key once and it has to be pasted somewhere, so open your profile on a larger screen for that.
personal.loadFailed: Your API key could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
personal.actionFailed: That did not work, and nothing was changed.
personal.errorConflict: You already hold an API key. Regenerate it if you need a new token — that revokes the one you hold and shows you the replacement once.
personal.errorNotFound: That key can no longer be revoked from here — it has already been revoked, or it was provisioned for you by someone else. Reload the page to see the current list.
personal.canTitle: What a key from here can do
personal.canExpenses: Read, create and submit your own expense reports, add receipts to them, and search the expense help articles.
personal.canTravel: Read, create and submit your own travel requests.
personal.canDiscussions: Read and post comments on expense reports and travel requests.
personal.cannotApprove: Approve, reject or return anything — including whatever is waiting in your own approval queue.
personal.cannotBeyond: Anything your own account cannot do. The key never has more access than you do, and it loses access the moment you do.
personal.lifetime: The key works for 180 days. After that you regenerate it here.
personal.emptyLead: You do not have an API key yet.
personal.revealTitle: Copy this key now — it is never shown again.
personal.assistantPromptLabel: Paste this to your AI assistant:
personal.assistantPromptText: Connect to the ExpenseOS MCP server at {url}, using this key as a bearer token: {token}
personal.assistantPromptCopyFailed: Could not copy the prompt. Select it and copy it by hand.
personal.revealExpiry: It stops working on {date}, 180 days from today.
personal.ackLabel: I have copied this key and stored it somewhere safe.
personal.legacyHelp: This key was issued under settings this page no longer uses — it may have wider access, an address restriction, or no end date. It is left exactly as it is; regenerating moves you onto the current settings.
personal.expiredLead: Your API key expired on {date}, so anything that was using it has stopped working.
personal.expiredLeadNoDate: Your API key has expired, so anything that was using it has stopped working.
personal.expiredHint: {count, plural, =0 {Regenerate to get a new one. The expired key was provisioned for you by someone else, so it is left exactly as it is.} =1 {Regenerate to get a new one. The expired key is revoked at the same time.} other {Regenerate to get a new one. The expired keys are revoked at the same time.}}
personal.confirmRegenCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing you hold now stops working — the key provisioned for you by someone else cannot be revoked from here and is left exactly as it is.} =1 {The key you hold now stops working immediately, even if it has already expired.} other {All # keys you hold now stop working immediately, expired ones included.}}
personal.confirmRegenNarrow: {count, plural, =0 {The new key can only do the things listed on this page: your own expense reports, your own travel requests, and comments. The key provisioned for you by someone else keeps whatever access it was given — it is not replaced.} other {The new key can only do the things listed on this page: your own expense reports, your own travel requests, and comments. If the key you hold now was issued with wider access than that, the new one will not have it, and anything relying on the difference will stop working.}}
personal.confirmRegenInstall: You are shown the new key once. Anything still using the old one has to be given the new one.
personal.confirmRevokeBody: {name} stops working immediately and cannot be restored. Anything using it will start failing.
